Problem Statement:
Given a set of integers and a target sum, determine whether there exists a subset of the given set whose sum is exactly equal to the target sum. If such a subset exists, print "Yes", otherwise print "No". 
Input Description:
- The first line contains two integers N and S, where N is the number of elements in the set and S is the target sum.
- The second line contains N space-separated integers representing the elements of the set. 
Output Description:
- Print "Yes" if there exists a subset whose sum is equal to S, otherwise print "No". 
Sample Input:
5 9
3 34 4 12 5
4 11
1 2 3 4 
Sample Output:
Yes
No 
Explanation:
There exists a subset {4, 5} whose sum is 9.
No subset sums up to 11.
